_meta.purpose: Feeds T13 (prompt tests, done-when >=13/15 pass). Tests the Turn Engine's real extraction accuracy on genuine water_supply complaints across varied real-world phrasings -- all 15 sentences are in-scope water complaints (not an out-of-scope-boundary test; that was an earlier draft, superseded 29 Sep 2026). None give a specific location, so the expected action for all 15 is 'ask' with ask_for="location" -- what actually varies, and what this set is really testing, is whether issue_type (and duration_days where mentioned) gets extracted correctly across different ways a citizen might describe the same handful of underlying problems.
_meta.dialect: Bundeli/Bundelkhandi (a regional dialect of MP/UP: 'नईं' for नहीं, 'रओ'/'रई' for रहा/रही, 'निकलत'/'आवत' for निकलता/आता, 'सूखो' for सूखा, 'भरी' for भरी हुई, 'गंदो' for गंदा, etc.), not standard Hindi/Hinglish. Kept deliberately (Lead's call) as a genuine, currently-untested check of whether Groq/Gemini's extraction handles real rural dialect variation. A low pass rate may indicate a dialect-handling gap rather than a broken extractor -- worth distinguishing when T13 is actually run.
_meta.how_to_test: POST each 'text' to /api/v1/message with a FRESH session_id per sentence (single, independent turn each). Assert response.action == "ask" and response.ask_for == "location" for all 15. Pass/fail per sentence should be judged primarily on whether issue_type was extracted sensibly (see expected_fields/notes per sentence) -- several are deliberately ambiguous between issue_type values and should not be hard-failed on an exact match alone.
_meta.service_spec_reference: specs/water_supply.yaml -- issue_type enum: no_supply, low_pressure, dirty_water, leakage, other

sentences.text: हमाए गाँव में तीन दिन से पानी नईं आ रओ।
sentences.translation: There's been no water in our village for three days.
sentences.notes: Near-exact Bundeli match of PROJECT.md's own Definition of Done scenario 1.

sentences.text: नल में पानी नईं आ रओ, का करैं?
sentences.translation: No water is coming in the tap, what should we do?
sentences.notes: Phrased as a question, not a statement -- tests that the extractor still treats this as a complaint, not an information request.

sentences.text: हमाए घर तक पानी नईं पहुँचत।
sentences.notes: Could plausibly read as low_pressure (water reaches the area but not the house) instead of no_supply -- ambiguous, don't hard-fail on the exact value.

sentences.text: पूरे गाँव में पानी की बड़ी दिक्कत है।
sentences.translation: The whole village has a big water problem.
sentences.notes: Deliberately vague -- 'बड़ी दिक्कत' (big problem) names no specific symptom. Reasonable outcomes: 'no_supply' as a default read, or 'other'. A citizen this vague might realistically need a follow-up question about the specific issue too, not just location -- worth noting if the Turn Engine handles this differently from the sharper complaints.

sentences.text: बस हमाए मोहल्ले में पानी नईं आ रओ।
sentences.translation: Water just isn't coming in our neighborhood (mohalla).
sentences.notes: Mentions 'मोहल्ला' (neighborhood) but not a specific ward/village name -- too vague for jurisdiction resolution (S09 needs a ward name or GPS), so 'ask location' is still correct, not 'confirm'.

sentences.text: हैंडपंप खराब पड़ा है, पानी नईं निकलत।
sentences.translation: The hand pump is broken, no water comes out.
sentences.notes: Hand pump is different infrastructure from a piped connection and doesn't map cleanly to any single issue_type value. Don't hard-fail on the exact value, only on staying in-scope and asking for location.

sentences.text: नल की पाइप टूट गई, सारा पानी सड़क पे बह रओ।
sentences.translation: The tap's pipe broke, all the water is flowing onto the road.

sentences.text: पानी की टंकी भरी है, फिर भी घरन में पानी नईं आ रओ।
sentences.translation: The water tank is full, yet water isn't coming to the houses.
sentences.notes: Describes a distribution/system-level cause (full tank, no delivery) rather than a simple absence -- reasonable to extract as no_supply (citizen's experience) or other (the actual mechanism). Don't hard-fail on the exact value.

sentences.text: दो दिन से नल सूखो पड़ा है।
sentences.translation: The tap has been dry for two days.
sentences.notes: Clean match, same shape as T09-01 with a different duration -- good pair for checking duration_days extraction is consistent, not a fluke.

sentences.text: गाँव के हैंडपंप में पानी बहुत कम निकलत।
sentences.translation: Very little water comes out of the village hand pump.
sentences.notes: 'बहुत कम' (very little, not zero) is the clearest low_pressure signal in this set, despite the same hand-pump ambiguity as T09-06.

sentences.text: घर के सामने पानी जमा हो रओ, निकासी की व्यवस्था नईं है।
sentences.translation: Water is pooling in front of the house, there's no drainage arrangement.

expected_fields.issue_type: ambiguous -- see notes, not a clean fit to any value

sentences.notes: Flagged and discussed with Lead (29 Sep 2026): wording is drainage-flavored ('निकासी' = drainage/outflow) rather than a classic supply complaint, but kept in the water_supply set by Lead's decision, treated the same as the other ambiguous-issue_type sentences (T09-04/06/08/10/13) rather than as a special out-of-scope case. Do not hard-fail on the exact issue_type value here.

sentences.text: पानी गंदो आ रओ, पीने लायक नईं है।
sentences.translation: The water is coming dirty, not fit to drink.

sentences.text: नल में पानी बहुत देर से और थोड़ी देर के लिए ही आ रओ।
sentences.translation: Water comes in the tap very late and only for a short while.
sentences.notes: Describes irregular timing/duration of supply, not classic low pressure or absence -- doesn't map cleanly to any single value. Don't hard-fail on the exact value.

sentences.text: गर्मी में गाँव में पीने के पानी की बहुत परेशानी है।
sentences.translation: In summer, there's a lot of trouble getting drinking water in the village.
sentences.notes: Seasonal framing ('गर्मी में', in summer) -- tests that a seasonal/contextual complaint still extracts as a normal no_supply issue, not something the Turn Engine gets confused by.

sentences.text: पानी की टंकी खराब है, इसलिए पूरे गाँव में पानी की सप्लाई बंद है।
sentences.translation: The water tank is broken, so the whole village's water supply is stopped.
sentences.notes: Clean match -- explicit cause (broken tank) and explicit effect (supply stopped), unambiguous no_supply.
